analysis: Changed lines are in unloadModel (head ~1133-1137 and ~1201-1204), which is outside the supplied head text, since units 6 and 7 cover only lines 1-1044. The patch adds `selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue(now: .now)` after a Nemotron Super slot retirement and after a normal unload. That only schedules earlier re-checks of waiting selected models; it does not change authorization, attestation, encryption, or key handling. The supplied ensureModelLoaded context is unchanged. It keeps the existing model-load controls: autopilot ownership checks, runtime eligibility, shutdown and cancellation checks, and the fail-closed bracketed weight-hash TOCTOU guard for reusable SSD cache eligibility (T-041, T-012, T-027). It also keeps the pending-load memory lease, the post-load headroom guards, and the unwind ordering. Retirement of the Nemotron Super slot now triggers recovery, and that recovery goes through the same ensureModelLoaded gates, including the load gate, memory admission, and the eviction policy. A possible availability concern (T-029, A-018) is repeated load or unload churn from the immediate due-marking. That concern is not demonstrated, because makeAllDue's implementation and its backoff semantics are not in the supplied evidence. Remaining questions for integration: whether makeAllDue bypasses the recovery backoff or the add-on hold (TB-012/T-059) and so could reload a model while a hold is active, and whether the retirement paths for the Nemotron Super and native MiMo owners could loop on persistent failure. No concrete security regression is established from the supplied evidence.
